g.text: Guide Residue a1 Anchor • Distance ≤ 4.5 Å
• Conserved Basic Pocket: K533, K570, R812, Y529
• Bulky conjugate at 5' end: Fatal (−35 pts)
• Loss of negative charge completely aborts RISC loading
• Enforces rigid C3'-endo North ribose pucker for rapid
target mRNA nucleation and base pairing
• Internal PS linkages in seed: −12 pts (ΔTm drop)
Alnylam ESC+: (S)-GNA at a7 relieves seed off-targets
Active Slicing Tetrad: D597, E632, D669, H807 ≤ 5.5 Å
• Coordinates divalent Mg2+ ions around target scissile bond
• Strict minor groove hydration requirements for RNase H cleavage
• Permitted: 2'-Fluoro (small VDW radius) or unmodified RNA
• Locked LNA at position 10: Complete Catalytic Abort
• Bulky modifications physically distort Ago2 slicing cleft
HelixZero Rule: Strictly preserves 2'-F / RNA at pos 9–11
• PAZ pocket cradles 2-nt dinucleotide guide overhang
• Shielding: Phosphorothioate linkages protect against exonucleases
• Conjugation: Trivalent GalNAc tethered to 3' sense strand
• Excessive internal PS across whole duplex: −25 pts (cytotoxicity)
• Unprotected 3'-ends: serum half-life drops below 1 hour
Delivery: ASGPR receptor uptake via 3' GalNAc

svg.text: Unified Target Mismatch Gating & Biophysical Calibration Formulation:
M_weighted = 2.5 × M_seed + 1.0 × M_non-seed | f_gate = exp( −1.2 × (M_weighted − 3.0) ) [if M_weighted > 3.0]
Final Calibrated Score = f_gate × max( 0.0, y_raw − γ ∑ P_d ) [with calibrated scaling factor γ = 0.12]
